title: docs/guide-regulars.md: for contributors
description: Flag day: create an SSH key (hardware recommended; FIDO ed25519-sk), register, optional continuity proof, get endorsed, get approved as contributor, git vouch setup. Day to day: signing commits and tags, git vouch sync/status. Rotation, endorsing others, lost key. Shortest of the three.
acceptance_criteria: All commands run successfully in a throwaway registry (doc test); links to vouching.md.
notes: Review fixes: five-section layout; carol's fresh registration is a run block on the page; draft review split from the signing loop; principal check after verify; OpenSSH 9.6 DST caveat pinned by test_dst_caveat_on_the_page_holds; revoked-key fail and replacement-key verify tested.
